# Praetor Documentation Index

> Enterprise Fleet Governance, Repository-as-Code & Universal AI Agent Engineering Engine.

## Core Governance & Invariants

- [HISS Formal Specification](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/standards/hiss-spec/): Complete specification of HISS-01 through HISS-21 invariants.
- [Model Routing & Capacity Arbiter](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/standards/model-routing-and-fanout/): Orchestration and fallback cascade for frontier and open models.
- [Agent Hooks & Operating Harness](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/guides/agent-hooks/): Canonical operating instructions and native client hook coverage.
- [Archetype Authoring](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/guides/archetype-authoring/): Archetype authoring, lattice joins, and profile manifests.
- [Developer Onboarding](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/guides/onboarding/): Developer setup, Git hooks, and environment bootstrapping.
- [Architectural Decision Records](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/adr/): ADR directory and architectural decision history.

## CLI Reference & Tooling

- [Fast Repository Adoption](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/adoption/): One-step repository onboarding through the CLI, MCP, and hosted automation.
- [Universal Dogfooding & Public Benchmarks](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/dogfooding/): Self-governance auditing and dry-run benchmarking against non-owned public repositories.
- [API Reference](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/wiki/API-Reference/): Existing command and service reference for praetorctl and standardsctl.
- [Operational Sync & Branch Protection](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/guides/operational-sync/): Declarative reconciliation of hosted rules, labels, and branch protection.

## Community & Funding

- [Polar.sh Issue Bounties](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/sponsoring/): Feature bounties and contributor rewards split via Polar.sh MoR.
- [Monetization Strategy](https://cordanallm.github.io/praetor/monetization/): In-IDE passive monetization (Idlen) and enterprise licensing framework.
